spans.s:
f. (-म्पा)
The name of a river, in the south of India.
E.
पा to drink, प Uṇādi aff., मन् inserted, and the radical vowel made short.

mfn. (-म्पः-म्पी-म्पं)
Belonging to the river, (Pampā.)
E.
पम्पा, and अण् aff.

m. (-घ्नः)
Sulphur.
E.
पामन् scab, and अघ्न destroying.

nf. (-म-मा)
Cutaneous eruption, herpes, scab.
E.
पै to dry, aff. मनिन्.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Diseased with herpes.
E.
पामन् herpes, and न aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
1 Wicked, vile, low, base.
2 Stupid, an idiot, a fool.
E.
पाम scab, and रा to get, क aff.

f. (-रा)
A plant: see गुडुची.
E.
पामर here said to mean bile, उद् before हृ to take away, aff. घञ् and टाप्.

m. (-रिः)
Sulphur.
E.
पामा scab, and अरि an enemy.
